digest.component_or_area: test-only reliability oracles for subprocess and network timeouts
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted consumes 15+ seconds with a production 10-second low-speed window instead of injected test-only short window
test_read_retried_then_terminal consumes ~9 seconds with real process sleeps matching production 2s/4s backoff schedule instead of recorded logical schedule
injection of 1-second low-speed window into snapshot test while maintaining real loopback socket traffic above floor for one complete window reduces wall time without changing contract

injection of sub-second call/grace/drain values into ACLI test through existing seams and recording of logical retry schedule without sleeping reduces wall time while retaining exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real sessions
spawned PIDs from ACLI read sentinel must be polled and verified absent after terminal failure to prove no orphaned process groups survive
